author: Akien
prose:
intention: an infernce call is made. a task ticket is created with all the information. who asked (because we can crawl the call chain), what the requesst was, what the answer was, model specified if any, model selected, provider specified if any, provider selected, escalations along the way and their back and forth, exceptions thrown would be included, if an entry went by graph trees first, nodes that came back, and so on. everything we might need in order to learn from the call, or to debug a failure later. if there was a failure, a trouble ticket call would also be made, pointing at the log entry. if there's already a trouble ticket, this call would get added to the existing ticket. and finally if it's completely unable to resolve the request it should also send back an intelligable message explaining the failure.

[immediately following, correcting/forking the 'who asked' clause above]

call chain or message envelope!
